name: HAVSRIS Cord set with switch, white, 15 ' 5 "
notes: Flags: no-dimensions (a cord set: its Measurements rows are 'Cord length: 15 ' 5 "; Max. load: 4 lb; Max.: 22 W', no footprint), so it goes in the layouts' extras, never placed. Fit: carries the GULLSUDARE paper shade (ikea-90603869) over the dining table without a ceiling box: 'To be hung on a ceiling hook. 2 ceiling hooks are included', so one hook goes over the table's center and the cord runs along the ceiling and down the wall to an outlet; the switch is on the cord. Good to know: 'Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E26. Shade is sold separately.' Safety: 'For safety's sake, hang out of reach of children'; the page carries a California Prop 65 warning (lead). PVC cord, acetal hanger, polycarbonate lampholder cup; wipe with a dry cloth. The US list has no HEMMA; HAVSRIS is the plug-in cord set it offers. Best seller badge on this page; 4.8 stars (99). In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY on 2026-10-22. rooms: dining-room, from the staging brief.
